extDescription.message: Rotate YouTube videos and crop black bars to fill the player. Rotation carries into picture-in-picture. No data collected.

detectNotReady.message: The video is not ready yet

detectBlocked.message: The picture of this video cannot be read

detectBlank.message: The picture stays black. Try again while the video is playing

detectTooLarge.message: The detected bars are too large to be right

detectNone.message: There are no black bars inside this video

resetForNewVideo.message: New video: picture ratio and rotation were reset

popupNotYoutube.message: Open this on a YouTube video page

popupNoScript.message: The extension is not attached to this tab yet. The tab was already open when it was installed or updated. Please reload the tab

popupNoVideo.message: Play a video to use the controls

popupOpenPanel.message: Open the panel in the player

popupNote.message: All controls are in the panel inside the player. The same panel works in fullscreen.

pipNoRotate.message: A rotated picture cannot be shown in the built-in picture-in-picture

ratioTitle.message: Picture ratio. Crops black bars baked into the video

detectTitle.message: Reads the playing picture to find black bars inside the video

windowFillTitle.message: Makes the player fill the browser window ($1)

pipTitle.message: Opens a small always-on-top window that keeps the rotation ($1)

flipWheelTitle.message: Reverses the direction of seeking with the wheel

strideTitle.message: Frames to step per wheel notch while holding Alt

pictureTitle.message: Draws the video into the preview. When off, only the outline remains and nothing is drawn

viewTitle.message: Drag the bright box. Double-click to center it

previewBlocked.message: The picture of this video cannot be read

noteRotatedFit.message: The rotated picture is scaled to fit inside the player.

noteNoRoom.message: With the chosen ratio there is no room left to enlarge.

noteAlreadyFills.message: This video already fills that direction. If black bars are baked into the video, try Detect.
